description: CORES, the Spanish strategic petroleum reserves agency, compiles statistics from the data that every hydrocarbon operator in Spain must report to it, and shares responsibility with the Ministry for the Ecological Transition for several energy statistics in the National Statistical Plan. Its statistics page offers updated series as spreadsheets: crude imports by country (since 1960), domestic crude production, crude movements and refinery output, Spanish refinery capacity (since 1984), refinery production by product group, consumption of petroleum products by region and province (since 1996), by product group and in detail, product stocks, imports and exports, the annual product balance and consumption by sector, and for natural gas the annual balance, consumption, stocks, production, and imports and exports by entry and exit point, plus a new annual series on gas consumption by direct market consumers. Coverage is Spain, by autonomous community and province for consumption; resolution is monthly or annual. Format and access: XLSX and XLS downloads, monthly bulletins and annual reports in PDF, and a free subscription for release alerts. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CORES legal notice: reproduction or modification of site content needs prior written permission. Free. Caveats: series start in different years and were extended back to 1960 in 2019. Simulation uses: fuel demand and supply chain inputs for energy security, refinery outage and stock drawdown scenarios. Related records: complements the JODI-Oil World Database and Eurostat energy statistics.
